size.description: Token amount for this row. On `REDEEM` rows it is the number of tokens burned for this row's outcome, so redeeming both sides of a market returns one row per outcome instead of a single combined row.

usdcSize.description: USDC amount for this row. On `REDEEM` rows it is the payout for this row's outcome and is `0` for a losing outcome; the rows of one redemption sum to the total payout.

asset.description: Token ID this row refers to. Populated on `REDEEM` rows with the token that row settles. Empty when the row is not token-specific.

outcomeIndex.description: Zero-based index of this row's outcome in the market's `outcomes` array, so `outcome` always equals `outcomes[outcomeIndex]`. On `REDEEM` rows it identifies the outcome the row settles, not the market's winning outcome. `999` means the outcome could not be determined, in which case `outcome` is empty.

icon.description: Market artwork. Falls back to the market image, then to the parent event's icon and image, when the market has no icon of its own. Empty on `CONVERSION` rows.

isCombo.description: True when this row is part of a combinatorial (multi-market) position. Flag only — combo detail is not embedded here. The row's conditionId equals the combo's combo_condition_id; pass it to /v1/activity/combos or /v1/positions/combos via market_id to fetch legs and detail. Omitted on non-combo rows.

grossInitialValue.description: Remaining entry basis including attributed BUY fees, at six-decimal source precision. `initialValue` and `avgPrice` keep their fee-exclusive semantics, so the fee-exclusive basis is `grossInitialValue - entryFeesUsdc`. Optional: treat an omitted field as unavailable rather than as zero.

entryFeesUsdc.description: Attributed BUY-fee component of `grossInitialValue`, at six-decimal source precision. SELL fees are exit costs and are never included. Returned as an explicit `0` when the fee component is zero. Optional: treat an omitted field as unavailable rather than as zero.

rank.description: The rank position of the builder

builderCode.description: The builder's onchain attribution code as attached to orders via `builderCode` (see CLOB V2). Empty string for legacy builders without a registered code.

get.description: Returns user activity with pagination and filtering.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Upper-bound timestamp (epoch seconds) for the activity window. Omit for the default (current time); rows newer than `end` are excluded.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of event IDs. Mutually exclusive with market.

parameters.name: excludeDepositsWithdrawals
parameters.description: Excludes deposit and withdrawal records. The default `true` applies even when `type` requests those records, so to get deposits and withdrawals you must pass `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Values above the maximum are clamped to 500.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of condition IDs. Mutually exclusive with eventId.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Starting index for pagination. Requests past the cap are rejected with a 400 (never silently clamped). To read history deeper than offset 5000, page inside `start`/`end` windows — each window has its own offset budget.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: `DESC` (default) returns the newest rows first; `ASC` the oldest first. Both orders are stable — the same query returns the same rows at any `limit`/`offset`, so pages compose without gaps or repeats.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Lower-bound timestamp (epoch seconds) for the activity window. Omit or pass `0` for the default window (most recent ~3 years); pass a positive epoch (e.g. `1`) to retrieve full history. With `sortDirection=ASC`, omitting `start` already reads from the beginning of the account's history (no default window).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of activity types to include. DEPOSIT and WITHDRAWAL records also require `excludeDepositsWithdrawals=false`.
